scope: diagnostic inventory-time subproblems; never original-F bounds
historical_rounding: nearest integer heuristic from last recorded fractional root Y
fourth_pattern: D3 inventory from this round's frozen initialization-plus-16-generations PREFIX
optimal_solution_numerical_gate: available primal quality and (LP) dual quality, each violation <=1e-5
released_inventory: -1 leaves original station, route and service variables in the model

conflict_attempt.selection: among proven strictly time-infeasible historical patterns, largest LB/T
conflict_attempt.release_order: zero-displacement stations together first if any, then smallest absolute displacement with depot-distance tie breaking
conflict_attempt.accept_release: remaining conditions still have valid LB strictly above T, or proven time-independent infeasibility
conflict_attempt.unknown_or_feasible_release: retain last proved conflict; do not infer infeasibility from failure to find a route
conflict_attempt.static_cut_gate: only if a reduced conflict is reusable, violates a recorded relevant LP bit point, and its cost is supported; otherwise no static cut trial
